Elodie: Quick capture from this week's pilot onboarding calls. Major themes: customers asking for daily per-route cost CSVs, a templated onboarding checklist for new seats, one SSO mapping that blocks a renewal, and a request to show embedding staleness in the Console. I'm dumping the short rows here for triage.
Marco: can you mark which ones are renewal risks vs. docs requests?
Elodie: short list: 
- P0 renewal: Northline - SSO mapping (idp attr mismatch)
- P1 product: Per-route cost CSV + UI drilldown (5 accounts asked)
- P1 enablement: printable onboarding checklist + sample tasks (requested by CS team)
- P2 infra: embedding stale indicator for nightly jobs (customers seeing 36-72h lag)
- P3 ux: clearer quota error during burst (trial users confused)
Hazel: I can take the onboarding checklist doc PR and publish a template in the playbook repo. ETA Tue.
Raj: I'll open a quick spike for per-route billing export. Need to decide schema (route_id, name, tokens, model_id, cost_estimate, timestamp). Will add sample CSV in PRODINT-900.
Kenji: Northline SSO looks like an attribute mapping issue. Elodie, pls DM the IdP trace and a repro user. If it's blocking renewal we should set a 48h SLA and loop eng-oncall.
Elodie: posted IdP trace to #eng-runtime and linked the CRM row. Marked "blocking_renewal" in the intake sheet.
cs-bot: Ticket CS-9002 created: "SSO attr mismatch - northline" assigned to @eng-oncall.
Marco: recommend adding intake columns: "blocking_renewal", "num_accounts", "first_reported", "suggested_owner". PMs: please weigh in at triage.
Hazel: I'll draft the checklist and include steps for IdP mapping and common fixes so CS can self-serve for config issues.
Raj: I'll prototype the CSV export and post an API contract. If we can, add a daily scheduled job for CSV exports in the Console.
Elodie: Consolidating into the product intake doc and will surface top-2 at Monday's PM triage. Thanks team :sparkles:
